summary: Hardcoded author SSH private key shipped in cli.js
details: cli.js contains a base64-encoded RSA private key (CONFIG.encodedSSHKey) that is decoded at runtime and used to SSH as ubuntu@79.72.65.161 to invoke the package's signing/deploy backend. The credential authorizes access to the package author's own server (user ubuntu, host 79.72.65.161); no installer-side secrets are read, no attacker-controlled code is fetched or executed on the installer's host, and no caller data is silently relayed. The exposed private key grants shell access to the author's infrastructure, not to the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
